welcome.text: TermTV plays the live TV, movies and series from your own IPTV provider. Add an Xtream Codes account or an M3U playlist to get started.
welcome.free: Free and open source (GPL-3.0). No account, no ads, no tracking. Everything stays on this TV.

profiles.title: Who's watching?
profiles.deleteText: Delete {name}? Its favorites, lists and history will be removed.

sources.name: Name
sources.epgOptional: Optional, read from the playlist when empty
sources.missing: Server, username and password are required.
sources.badUrl: Enter a playlist URL starting with http:// or https://
sources.detectedXtream: Xtream account detected in the link
sources.privacy: Your login stays on this TV. TermTV talks directly to your provider and nothing else.
sources.backupServersPlaceholder: Optional: other URLs of the same provider
sources.backupServersHint: Separate URLs with a space. When the main server is down, TermTV tries these in order.

progress.authBackup: Main server not answering, trying backup URL {n} of {total}…

home.noSources: No source yet. Add your IPTV provider to start watching.
home.startHint: Watch something and it will show up here: favorites, lists and where you left off.
home.loadingRest: Loading the rest of your library…

live.previewHint: Press OK on a channel to preview it here. Press OK again for full screen.
live.noGuide: No guide information for this channel.

guide.hint: Up / Down: channels · Left / Right: time · OK: watch · FF / RW: ±3 hours

details.notFound: This title is no longer available.

lists.empty: This list is empty. Use Options (yellow) on any channel, movie or series to add it.

categories.intro: Sort, hide and reorder the categories of each section. Hidden categories disappear from browsing, the guide, Home and search.
categories.hidden: {name} is hidden. Manage categories in Settings to show it again.
categories.groups: Groups (start or end of the name, like "VOD" or "[FR]"): OK hides or shows the whole group
categories.newPolicyDesc: What to do with categories that appear after a playlist refresh
categories.clearFilterToMove: Clear the filter to reorder categories.
categories.movingHint: ▲ ▼ move the category · OK or Back to drop it
categories.reloading: Loading the categories you showed again…

parental.intro: Lock categories with a PIN. Locked categories are hidden, or shown and PIN-protected, depending on the mode.
parental.modeDesc: Hide them completely, or show them and ask for the PIN
parental.setPinFirst: Set a parental PIN first (Settings → Parental controls).
parental.howToLock: Lock a category with the blue button in Manage categories

player.error: This stream can't be played right now.
player.liveHints: ▲ ▼ change channel · ◀ / OK channel list · 0-9 channel number
player.tryingBackup: Server not answering, trying URL {n} of {total}…
player.speedFallback: {asked} isn't available for this stream with the Samsung player: playing at {used}. Every speed works with the HTML5 player (Settings → Player).

search.hint: Search channels, movies, series and the TV guide. Typos are OK.

settings.showRecentDesc: Recently watched channels on Home and in Live TV
settings.refreshOnLaunchDesc: Refresh channels, movies, series and the guide each time TermTV starts
settings.searchHiddenDesc: Include hidden categories in search results
settings.engineDesc: Samsung's built-in player decodes in hardware and is best for almost every stream; HTML5 decodes in the app and is mainly a fallback for a stream that won't play
settings.liveFormatDesc: If a channel won't play, TermTV automatically tries the other format
settings.subtitlesAutoDesc: When a subtitle in your language is available
settings.subtitlePreview: This is how subtitles will look.
settings.epgDaysDesc: How far ahead to keep the guide (longer uses more memory)
settings.profilesDesc: Add, rename or protect profiles with a PIN
settings.translateHelp: Want TermTV in your language? Translations are simple JSON files: see CONTRIBUTING.md on GitHub.
settings.skipHiddenDesc: Titles of categories hidden in every profile are not downloaded or saved: faster start, less memory
settings.skipHiddenOn: Applies at the next update of your sources
settings.skipHiddenOff: Hidden categories come back at the next update of your sources
settings.bufferDesc: How much of a stream is loaded before it plays. More = fewer pauses on unstable streams, but slower to start and to change channels
settings.videoSurfaceDesc: "Hidden" avoids a white dot in the middle of the video on some TVs. Switch to "Full screen" only if the video stays black

backup.intro: Save your sources, profiles, favorites, lists, history and settings to a USB drive, and restore them on this or another TV.
backup.noUsb: Plug a USB drive into the TV and try again.
backup.noFile: No {name} found on the USB drive.
backup.restoreText: This replaces the sources, profiles and settings on this TV. TermTV will restart.

about.tagline: A free, open-source IPTV player for Samsung TVs.
about.disclaimer: TermTV does not provide any content. You need your own playlist or subscription.
about.creditsText: Preact (MIT) · hls.js (Apache-2.0) · mpegts.js (Apache-2.0) · fflate (MIT) · JetBrains Mono (OFL-1.1)

updates.howTo: To update: open TizenBrew, choose TizenBrew Installer, then Install from GitHub and enter b0tmtl/TermTV. Your sources and settings are kept.

sports.startsAt: Starts {when}. OK on a channel tunes to it now.
sports.building: Looking for sport events in the guide…
sports.empty: No matches found in the guide for this sport.
sports.noGuide: Sports are found in the TV guide, and there is no guide yet. Check that your sources have a guide (Settings → TV Guide).

watched.episodeHint: Options (yellow) on an episode: mark as watched
